protocol.baseline: frozen round11 validation-selected random80_source_gt; no repeated training
protocol.dinov2: official ViT-S/14, frozen, final normalized patch tokens, no pretrained head
protocol.dinov2_input: shared 128x128 RGB -> bicubic 224x224; ImageNet mean/std; no GT masks/crops/prompts
protocol.patch_sampling: bilinear at 128-pixel centers, align_corners=False, border padding
protocol.supervision: source-frame GT only, identical query metadata
protocol.head: linear
protocol.checkpoint_selection: raw validation macro F1 every 50 steps; ties earlier checkpoint
protocol.calibration_selection: one shared offset per label arm, maximize mean validation macro F1 over three seeds
protocol.pretraining_ovis_image_overlap: unknown, cannot establish disjoint pretraining data

video_bootstrap.note: per-video present-class macro F1 estimand; not pooled-query macro F1 confidence interval
